:::{#def-mahalanobis}
#### Mahalanobis distance

For a $p \times p$ positive definite matrix $\matr{\covmat}$
and $\vx, \vecf{\mean} \in \reals^p$,
the **Mahalanobis distance** from $\vx$ to $\vecf{\mean}$ with respect to $\matr{\covmat}$ is:

$$
\mahal(\vx) \eqdef \sqrt{\tp{(\vx - \vecf{\mean})} \matr{\covmat}^{-1} (\vx - \vecf{\mean})}
$$

:::
